hooks.name: format-python
hooks.description: Formats and lints saved Python files with ruff. No-op until the uv workspace exists.

hooks.name: format-typescript
hooks.description: Formats saved TypeScript files with prettier. No-op until prettier is installed in node_modules.

hooks.name: profile-validate
hooks.description: Validates pedagogical profiles (YAML) against the profile schema. No-op until the wysp CLI exists (pedagogy-verification task 1).

hooks.name: task-tests
hooks.description: After a spec task completes, runs the tests of the packages changed in the working tree (Python and TypeScript).
